Original_text: A creepy vibe suddenly makes you shiver all over.
Translated: Aura menyeramkan tiba-tiba membuatmu meigil di seluruh tubuh.

Original_text: You keep telling yourself it's all fake. Stay positive and upbeat!
Translated: Kamu terus meyakinku bahwa ini semua palsu. Tetap positif dan semangat!

Original_text: You reach the hazardous spot mentioned by the mayor.
Translated: Kamu sampai di titik berbautkan oleh walikota.

Original_text: You work hard to fix the dangerous area. Now that's how you work!
Translated: Kamu bekerja keras untuk memperbaiki area berbahaya itu. Nah, begitu baru benar cara kerjanya!

Original_text: A chilly wind suddenly blows from behind.
Translated: Angin dingin tiba-tiba berhembus dari belakang.

Original_text: It's just your imagination. After all, the wind has you frozen in fear.
Translated: Itu hanya imajinasimu. Lagipula, angin itu membuatmu membeku ketakutan.

Original_text: The sign you put up last time seems to have tilted.
Translated: Papan tanda yang kamu pasang terakhir kali sepertinya miring.

Original_text: You leave a good impression on Shizuko.
Translated: Kamu memberikan kesan yang baik pada Shizuko.

Original_text: Shizuko gives you a hard knock on the head.
While checking for hazards, you suddenly step on a piece of glass.
Translated: Saat memeriksa bahaya, tiba-tiba kamu menginjak pecahan kaca.

Original_text: Shizuko shyly keeps pushing you away.
Translated: Shizuko dengan malu-malu terus mendorongmu menjauh.asdasdasd

Original_text: Shizuko watches you, laughing until she cries.
Your mind has been strengthened, increasing your resistance to stss!
Translated: Mentalmu telah diperkuat, meningkatkan resistensimu terhadap stres!

Original_text: Shizuko suddenly screams; turns out a droplet of something fell on her neck.
Translated: Shizuko tiba-tiba berteriak; ternyata ada tetesan sesuatu yang jatuh di lehernya.

Original_text: It seems it's not water... but bat urine.
Translated: Sepertinya ini bukan air... tapi air seni kelelawar.

Original_text: Shizuko grabs you and runs outside again.
Translated: Shizuko menarikmu dan berlari ke luar lagi.

Original_text: The corner of the abandoned hospital is occupied by monkeys, who are now staring fiercely at you.
Translated: Sudut rumah sakit terbengkalai itu ditempati oleh monyet-monyet, yang sekarang menatapmu dengan tajam.

Original_text: The monkeys just watch you leave quietly.
Translated: Monyet-monyet itu hanya melihatmu pergi dengan tenang.

Original_text: Throw a rice ball at them
Translated: Lempar bola nasi ke arah mereka

Original_text: You don't have a rice ball, so you throw a condom instead. The monkeys seem to like it and toss coins back to you.
Translated: Kamu tidak punya bola nasi, jadi kamu melempar kondom sebagai gantinya. Monyet-monyet itu sepertinya menyukainya dan melemparkan koin kembali kepadamu.

Original_text: Your mood instantly becomes as calm as the sea.
Translated: Suasana hatimu seketika menjadi setenang laut.

Original_text: *Bleeee* *Hoo* *Hoo*...? You end up being chased around by the monkeys.
Translated: *Bleeee* *Hoo* *Hoo*...? Kamu akhirnya malah dikeoleh para monyet.

Original_text: Your sixth sense makes you stop, and you hesitate whether to go forward.
Translated: Indammu membuatmu berhenti, dan kamu ragu apakah harus lanjut maju.

Original_text: Shizuko seems kind of happy for some reason?
Translated: Shizuko tampak agak senang karena alasan tertentu?

Original_text: The impact this is having on your mind is getting stronger.
Translated: Dampak hal ini terhadap pikiranmu menjadi semakin kuat.

Original_text: You find a clean spot and sit down to drink some hot water.
Translated: Kamu menemukan tempat yang bersih dan duduk untuk minum air panas.

Original_text: You think you hear a murmuring voice and turn to look at Shizuko, but she seems clueless.
Translated: Kamrasa mendengar suara gumaman dan menoleh untuk melihat Shizuko, tapi dia tampak tidak tahu apa-apa.

Original_text: You let out a good scream, which makes you feel better, but it startles Shizuko.
Translated: Kamu brtriak kencang, yang membuatmu merasa lebih baik, tapi itu mengejutkan Shizuko.

Original_text: It's just a noise, that's all.
Translated: Itu cuma suara bising, itu saja.

Original_text: Your adrenaline is pumping, which strengthens your mind.

Translated: Merapalkan kitab suci Buddha dalam hati

Original_text: Look at Shizuko and think naughty thoughts
Translated: Lihat Shizuko dan pikirkan hal-hal mesum

Original_text: Shizuko covers herself, looking at you in disbelief.
Translated: Shizuko menutupi tubuhnya, menatagan tidak percaya.

Original_text: You tidy up some recyclables the mayor asked to be brought back.
Translated: Kamu merapikan beberapa barang daur ulang yang diminta walikota untuk dibawa kembali.

Original_text: Shizuko slips away on the way back because she really wants to get a bath in. How heartless.
Translated: Shizuko menyelinap pergi saat jalan pulang karena dia benar-benar ingin mandi. Tega sekali.

Original_text: Although Shizuko complains a bit, she obediently helps carry it back.
Translated: Meskipun Shizuko sedikit mengeluh, dia patuh membantu membawanya kembali.

Original_text: It's pretty expensive to rent one. Better think twice next time.
Translated: Cukup mahal untuk menyewanya. Lebih baik pikir dua kali lain kali.

Original_text: You find a child's glowing toy, which seems a bit scary in this setting...
Translated: Kamu menemukan mainan anak-anak yang bercahaya, yang terasa agak menyeramkan di suasana seperti ini...

Original_text: You accidentally hit the toy's switch, and it slides away.
Translated: Kamu tdak sengaja menek saklaainannya, dan benda itu tergelincir menjauh.

Original_text: You carefully pick up the toy... seems like everything's fine.
Translated: Kamu mengambil mainan itu dengan hati-hati... sepertinya semuanya baik-baik saja.

Original_text: Shizuko laughs joyously at your timid approach.
Translated: Shizuko tertawa riang melihat pendekatanmu yang penakut.

Original_text: You see the pink cat mentioned by the mayor... looks kinda familiar?
Translated: Kamu melihat kucing merah muda yang disebutkan oleh walikota... terlihat agak familiar?

Original_text: Pull out a can of cat food

Translated: Berhasil menjinakkan kucing merah muda itu!

Original_text: You and the pink cat engage in a fierce battle!
Translated: Kamu dan kucing merah muda itu tat dalam pertarungan sengit!

The pink cat disappears, and Shizuko gives you an annoyed knock on the head!
